# Native build of the official OpenVPN 3 core client for Tidewall's
# Direct OpenVPN mode. Sources are fetched by ../../../fetch-deps.sh and the
# SWIG JNI wrapper is generated by the Gradle "swigOpenVpn3" task.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(tidewall_ovpn3 C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)

set(DEPS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../deps")
if (NOT OVPN3_SWIG_CXX)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "OVPN3_SWIG_CXX (generated ovpncli_wrap.cxx) is not set")
endif ()

# --- mbed TLS -----------------------------------------------------------------
set(ENABLE_PROGRAMS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ENABLE_TESTING OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(USE_SHARED_MBEDTLS_LIBRARY OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(USE_STATIC_MBEDTLS_LIBRARY ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(MBEDTLS_FATAL_WARNINGS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(${DEPS}/mbedtls mbedtls EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)

# --- fmt ----------------------------------------------------------------------
set(FMT_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(${DEPS}/fmt fmt EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)

# --- lz4 / xxHash -------------------------------------------------------------
add_library(tw_lz4 STATIC ${DEPS}/lz4/lib/lz4.c ${DEPS}/lz4/lib/lz4hc.c)
target_include_directories(tw_lz4 PUBLIC ${DEPS}/lz4/lib)

add_library(tw_xxhash STATIC ${DEPS}/xxhash/xxhash.c)
target_include_directories(tw_xxhash PUBLIC ${DEPS}/xxhash)

# --- OpenVPN 3 core + JNI wrapper ------------------------------------------------
add_library(ovpn3 SHARED
        ${DEPS}/openvpn3/client/ovpncli.cpp
        ${DEPS}/openvpn3/openvpn/crypto/data_epoch.cpp
        ${OVPN3_SWIG_CXX})

target_include_directories(ovpn3 PRIVATE
        ${DEPS}/openvpn3
        ${DEPS}/openvpn3/client
        ${DEPS}/asio/asio/include)

target_compile_definitions(ovpn3 PRIVATE
        USE_MBEDTLS
        USE_ASIO
        ASIO_STANDALONE
        ASIO_NO_DEPRECATED
        HAVE_LZ4
        OPENVPN_CORE_GIT_VERSION="release/3.11.7"
        OPENVPN_SHOW_SESSION_TOKEN
        OPENVPN_ALLOW_INSECURE_CERTPROFILE)

target_compile_options(ovpn3 PRIVATE -Wno-deprecated-declarations -fexceptions -frtti)

target_link_libraries(ovpn3 PRIVATE
        mbedtls mbedx509 mbedcrypto
        tw_lz4 tw_xxhash fmt::fmt
        log)

target_link_options(ovpn3 PRIVATE "LINKER:--build-id=none" "LINKER:-z,max-page-size=16384")
